decides: 光从哪来、什么颜色、多硬——光影是情绪的总开关，同一构图换光就是另一张脸

items.prompt: golden hour side light, long warm shadows raking across surfaces, low sun angle with honey-colored rim on hair and shoulders, sky gradient from amber to pale blue
items.note: 低日角的暖色轮廓光是签名

items.prompt: neon practical lighting, competing magenta and cyan sources from opposite sides rimming the subject, shadows crushed toward black with almost no fill, colored reflections in every wet surface
soft overcast daylight, shadowless even illumination from the whole sky, muted gentle contrast, colors at their true value without directional drama
items.note: 无影光适合日常与情绪内戏

items.prompt: stage spotlight lighting, one hard key beam from above with visible haze volume, sharp falloff into surrounding darkness, audience area completely unlit, one accent colored wash from the side
items.note: 聚光的体积靠雾让光有形

items.prompt: candlelight interior, small flickering warm source with irrational dancing shadows, deep brown falloff into corners, everything within one meter lit and beyond swallowed
items.note: 火光的 flicker 与短衰减是签名

items.prompt: strong backlight from behind the subject, silhouette with only a thin rim of hair and shoulder picked out, background light source visible or implied, foreground crushed to near-black
items.note: 逆光先牺牲细节，换轮廓

items.prompt: harsh midday sun directly overhead, short dark shadows under the brow and nose, bleached highlights, saturated unmodulated colors, sharp-edged contact shadows
items.note: 顶光的压迫感来自眼下三角阴影

items.prompt: moonlit blue night lighting, cool desaturated palette with one small warm practical accent, soft shadowless ambient from the sky, stars faintly visible in deep blue upper tones
items.note: 冷调里留一个暖点，夜就不冷

items.prompt: morning mist lighting, diffuse pale light with low saturation, air carrying visible depth between layered forms, distant shapes dissolving first, gentle dew sparkle on foreground edges
items.note: 雾是按距离溶解的，不是均匀加白

items.prompt: volumetric god rays through gaps in cloud or canopy, distinct shafts with visible dust motes inside, strong contrast between lit air and unlit air, one grounded bounce filling shadows
items.note: 丁达尔效应的关键是有介质
